mapper.select:
SELECT r.reservation_num, r.seat_number, r.payment_time, r.state, r.member_code, r.schedule_num,
s.seat_code, s.seat_type, s.price, s.screening_num, s.is_aisle, s.row_label, s.col_num,
m.member_code, m.member_name, m.id, m.password, m.phone_number,
sc.schedule_num, sc.screening_date, sc.screening_num, sc.movie_num,
i.movie_num, i.movie_title, i.running_time, i.audience_rating,
th.screening_num AS th_screening_num, th.screening_number, th.branch_num,
cf.branch_name, cf.address
FROM T_ReservationInfo r JOIN T_Seat s ON r.seat_number = s.seat_code JOIN T_MemberInfo m ON r.member_code = m.member_code JOIN T_Schedule sc ON r.schedule_num = sc.schedule_num JOIN T_Info i ON sc.movie_num = i.movie_num JOIN T_Theater th ON sc.screening_num = th.screening_num JOIN T_CinemaFranchise cf ON th.branch_num = cf.branch_num

SELECT r.reservation_num, r.seat_number, r.payment_time, r.state, r.member_code, r.schedule_num,
s.seat_code, s.seat_type, s.price, s.screening_num, s.is_aisle, s.row_label, s.col_num,
m.member_code, m.member_name, m.id, m.password, m.phone_number,
sc.schedule_num, sc.screening_date, sc.screening_num, sc.movie_num,
i.movie_num, i.movie_title, i.running_time, i.audience_rating,
th.screening_num AS th_screening_num, th.screening_number, th.branch_num,
cf.branch_name, cf.address
FROM T_ReservationInfo r JOIN T_Seat s ON r.seat_number = s.seat_code JOIN T_MemberInfo m ON r.member_code = m.member_code JOIN T_Schedule sc ON r.schedule_num = sc.schedule_num JOIN T_Info i ON sc.movie_num = i.movie_num JOIN T_Theater th ON sc.screening_num = th.screening_num JOIN T_CinemaFranchise cf ON th.branch_num = cf.branch_num WHERE r.member_code = #{memberCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_ReservationInfo ( reservation_num, seat_number, payment_time, state, member_code, schedule_num ) VALUES ( #{reservationNum}, #{seatNumber}, #{paymentTime}, #{state}, #{memberCode}, #{scheduleNum} )
